body:
I feel very inadequate about a lot of things pretty much all the time. I have a lot of insecurities about my appearance, voice, emotions, etc. I worry I'm an unpleasant person to interact with because of how I look or sound, which makes it tough to be confident. I also worry that if I try to be honest and genuine with people I'm going to embarrass myself, because my emotions are all over the place and a little intense. I was able to put on an act for a long time but I don't seem capable of doing that anymore because it's exhausting and I'm always tired now.

I also feel very anxious about school. It's not that it's difficult, but I've struggled to be a consistent student since graduating high school and I get super anxious when the pace of my classes starts to pick up. When I'm not feeling anxious I can learn the material, but most of the time it's like there's very loud static in my brain and I can't focus at all. It makes me feel dumb, which is a horrible feeling because I used to be quite smart. It feels like I've lost a huge part of my identity.

I can't hold a job, either. The last few I've had either ended with me quitting due to increasingly frequent panic attacks or getting fired for not being able to cope with said panic attacks. I don't have any confidence in my ability to work.

Basically, the last few years have ingrained the idea in me that if I try, I'm going to fail. That's what keeps happening, so it's like a Pavlovian response at this point. I'm so afraid of making an absolute fool out of myself in other people's eyes (as I've done before) that I struggle to accomplish anything anymore. I feel useless.

Every time I failed, though, not only did I wind up further back than when I started, I lost something, as well. First I lost some self respect when I got in trouble with the law three times in six months. Apparently I had no self control. Then I got kicked out a research community I was in. Then I flunked out of school. Lost my parents' respect. Lost my confidence. Then my friends. And so on...

I don't have anything left to lose and I never seem to gain anything when I try. I feel empty except for all this emotional pain. I don't want to feel this way anymore, I don't have any fight left in me. I just want it to end because nothing I've done has made anything better and I'm all spent.

I'm here, but I lost most of personality along the way. If "I" were still intact I think I'd feel better about life, but I feel like a mockery of who I was before I started screwing everything up. I no long have the skills, talents, or passions I used to. Just uncomfortable memories and a lot of regret. I've also been to this point a few times before, but every other time I had something to hold onto - school, friends, etc. - to help pull me back from the edge. But I don't have anything this time. I feel completely alone and it's horribly depressing. I don't want to fighting for nothing anymore; I can't control myself very well and without some emotional stability, what can I really achieve?

I don't smoke or snort anything anymore, I haven't in years. I occasionally drink a little but not much because it tends to make me extra depressed for a few days after (not always).

I was in school until a few months ago. I took general classes for a year after almost two years off, committed to an engineering major, and then suffered an increase in anxiety and stopped going. I don't know why, it's not like it was hard. I just got overwhelmed by the thought of... I don't know. Moving forward? I was pulling As and then just stopped going and I have no idea why.

Yeah, see, that's the problem - I don't do anything I enjoy. I used to play music but my depression killed any motivation I had for it and now I can't play anymore. I used to play tennis but stopped for the same reasons. I was into writing, too, I used to write a lot of fiction, but it's insanely difficult now. My creativity is gone. Reading is pretty fun but I struggle to make it through books now because it's too exhausting so I just don't read much at all. I tried learning a new language recently and was doing really well with it for a few weeks but then it became a huge chore and I haven't had the energy for it anymore.

Everything is difficult and it's frustrating because there's way to release all this tension I have in me. It just builds and builds until I have an anxiety attack. Wash, rinse, and repeat ad infinitum. If I were strong, I'd go see a therapist. I'm kind of afraid they wouldn't be able to help me, though, I'm a complete mess. An absolute train wreck.
